name: Materialize Polearm: materialize a Polearm card from your material deck
notes: WIND element access via the established Subcards lineage patch (Spirit of Wind). Steel Halberd (WARRIOR/POLEARM) is seeded directly into the Material zone (on top of the 5 default material cards, landing at myMaterial-4) as the choosable target. Full 4-reserve cost is paid (4x myHand-0, same pattern as summon-sentinels-drone-tokens), then a reserve-paid activated ability resolves through an EffectStack opportunity (same as favorable-winds-ally-life-buff) that must be declined ('-') before the MZMAYCHOOSE target-choice decisions appear. The CUSTOM handler resolves via DoMaterialize (GeneratedMacroCode.php:38036), bypassing Steel Halberd's own cost -- confirmed by myField-1.CardID = 'fvnvknj4dd' and myMaterial shrinking from 5 to 4.
